root_cause.note: Ping POST handler joins attacker JSON (ip_address, count, vnet_id) into the ping argv.

evidence.analysis: SONiC REST PingPost builds the ping argv from request JSON (ip_address, count '-c ' concatenation, vnet_id). argv-list exec means no shell metacharacters, but option injection into ping and unauthenticated-by-default REST auth mode (community change to default 'user' is recent) make this a live probe/injection surface. Not run dynamically: the go-server-server package links swsscommon (C), which cannot build on this Windows host.
